tenderSchedule.title: Design,Engineering, supply, installation, integrate, commissioning, and Testing of Gravity Winding System for existing double drum winder of New circular Shaft
tenderSchedule.description: Design, Engineering, supply, installation, integrate, commissioning, and Testing of Gravity Winding System for existing double drum winder of New circular Shaft, other details as per NIT.
tenderSchedule.locationName: HGML Sr Manager Met Section Hutti

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The payment and validity period in technical bid B & D should be same.
The document submitted by bidder in KPP Portal shall not be in corrupted/damaged/protected format.
If price bid is submitted in technical bid, then EMD will be FORFEITED and your offer will be REJECTED.
Bidder shall give undertaking that they have accepted our terms regarding Delivery/Completion, Validity & Payment as per format enclosed.
Bidders shall upload all the Documents in PDF format only.

As per the Government Orders vide FD 417 EXP-12-2024 dated: 09-08-2024, the bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all Other applicable taxes, levies, duties, Cess etc. in the Kppp portal dashboard.
All other terms and conditions as per the NIT.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder or the OEM (OEM means manufacturer of winders) of the proposed gravity winding system should have experience in the supply of a similar gravity winding system for a men-winding application with a capacity of not less than 500 KW during the last five years, purchase order and completion certificate to be enclosed.
Only Manufacture or Authorized dealers of quoted make are eligible to submit the bid. Relevant documents to be enclosed.
The bidder shall submit a detailed technical proposal comprising the complete technical specifications, working principle, and control philosophy of the proposed system.
If bidder is authorized dealer, then the bidder has to submit the undertaking letter from OEM in regard with successful installation & commissioning of gravity winding system.

The bidder should have in the last three years period i.e FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 achieved in at least one financial years the turnover per annum not less than Rs. 4.00 Crore, Relevant documents to be enclosed.
Detailed scheme for executing the work along with type and number of equipment, the Tenderer proposes to deploy as per requirements
Detailed Time Schedule consisting of every activity including preparatory works in sequential manner starting from the date of acceptance of the tender.
Details of work experience in respect of the tender
Turn-over and ITR details FY 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25.
Copies of Profit & Loss statement, Balance Sheets for FY 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 shall be enclosed.
Tenders of Sick Companies and Companies referred to BIFR will not be considered
Manufacturer Authorization certificate, if bidder is authorized dealer.
Tenders submitted by a party which is black listed by the Govt. agency will not be considered. Rejection in this regard can be done during course of tender also

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Undertaking as per Technical D should be attached and document can be downloaded from enclosures.
Duly filled technical bid B should be attached in Technical Bid and format can be downloaded from enclosure
Copies of Purchase Order/Completion Certificate/Satisfactory report as a proof for past experience
